newsitem.title: USA: Nabisco biscuit operating income rises.
newsitem.headline: Nabisco biscuit operating income rises.

text.p: Nabsico Holdings Corp said on Monday that its biscuit unit had operating revenue of $134 million for the first quarter, up seven percent from $125 million for the same period the year before.
Biscuit sales were down 8 percent, to $801 million from $871 million, reflecting a sales force reorganization and three fewer selling days in the more recent quarter, the company said.
The company said its results reflected efficiencies from a 1996 restructuring.
Oreo sales were up 23 percent, while Air Crisps grew 51 percent for the quarter. But Newtons and SnackWells declined, the company said.
The U.S. Foods Group unit operating income grew three percent, to $65 million from $63 million, even though sales were down 6 percent, to $527 million from $563 million.
The sales decline was due in part to a program to reduce retail inventory levels of condiments and tablespreads, the company said.
International sales were up four percent, to $577 million from $556 million. Operating income was $54 million, up eight percent from $50 million for the same period a year ago.
